description: This file defines a custom exception class named OperationNotAllowedException, which extends AbstractPlatformServiceUnavailableException. It is used to indicate that a certain job operation cannot be performed because a job is currently running.

classes.name: OperationNotAllowedException
classes.description: A RuntimeException indicating that a job operation is not allowed because the job is currently in progress.

methods.name: OperationNotAllowedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new OperationNotAllowedException with a specific message indicating the jobs that are currently running.

calls: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Object... args)
